mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, no codec is specified here.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded, and it names no codec.

The only compression decision in the project's memory was an early one to adopt zstd. A later recorded decision replaced it with an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL, and a third decision refers to zstd as the previous strategy. So no current codec is recorded. Nothing in the repository's files records one either. I left the retired option out of the file, as you asked.

The first attempt to create the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file tool instead. I haven't committed anything.
